method: Independent exact arithmetic and explicit derivation, separate from animation code
general_argument: Before n appends finish, copied capacities form1+2+...+2^k=2^(k+1)-1 with2^k<n; hence copies<2n. Adding n writes gives total<3n. Individual resizing still costs n item operations at that step.
limits: Item-copy/write model only; allocation, object-copy details and wall-clock latency are excluded. No deletions.
